_doc: Capability taxonomy for the card-text-driven tech-matchup detector. Each capability tag describes an effect a card has based on its rules text. Extracted by patterns in card_capability_patterns.json and matched against opposing-side tags by card_capability_interactions.json. The summary_en/de templates feed the Tech Lab UI as plain-language explanations of the underlying rule when this card is the picked target. affects_subset narrows down which attackers/defenders the tag interacts with (e.g. ex_immunity only blocks Pokemon ex attackers).

attack.ignores_effects.desc: Attack damage is not affected by any effects on the defending Pokemon. Bypasses damage-reduction abilities, KO-prevention abilities, EX-immunity, and bench-protection on the active. Example: Mega Lopunny ex (PFL 84) Spiky Hopper.
attack.ignores_effects.summary_en: Attacks ignore every effect on the defending Pokemon — damage lands regardless of KO-prevention, ex-immunity, or damage-reduction abilities.
attack.ignores_effects.summary_de: Angriffe ignorieren jeden Effekt auf dem verteidigenden Pokemon — Schaden landet ungeachtet von KO-Schutz, ex-Immunität oder Schadensreduktion.

attack.bench_damage.desc: Attack deals damage to one or more Benched Pokemon. Bypasses front-line bulk and pressures multi-prize backline targets. Example: Drayton (DRI 21) Dynamic Lightning, Charizard ex Burning Darkness.
attack.bench_damage.summary_en: Deals damage to the opponent's Benched Pokemon — pressures setup pieces and multi-prize targets behind the active.
attack.bench_damage.summary_de: Schaden auf der Bank des Gegners — setzt Setup-Stücke und Multi-Prize-Ziele hinter dem aktiven Pokemon unter Druck.

attack.weakness_bypass.desc: Attack damage is dealt regardless of Weakness — neutralises type-disadvantaged matchups where the opponent would otherwise be a hard counter.
attack.weakness_bypass.summary_en: Damage is dealt regardless of Weakness — type-disadvantaged matchups are neutralised.
attack.weakness_bypass.summary_de: Schaden wird unabhängig von Weakness gemacht — Typ-Nachteile werden neutralisiert.

ability.ko_prevention.desc: Survives a lethal attack with 1+ HP remaining when at full HP. Example: Crustle (BLK 130) Sturdy.
ability.ko_prevention.summary_en: Survives the first lethal hit with 1+ HP remaining (when at full HP). Bypassed by attacks that ignore effects on the defending Pokemon.
ability.ko_prevention.summary_de: Überlebt den ersten tödlichen Treffer mit 1+ HP (wenn auf voller HP). Wird umgangen von Angriffen die Effekte auf dem verteidigenden Pokemon ignorieren.

ability.ex_immunity.desc: Takes zero damage from Pokemon ex / Pokemon-EX attacks. Hard-walls every ex-attacker unless bypassed.
ability.ex_immunity.summary_en: Takes zero damage from Pokemon ex attacks. Non-ex Pokemon attack normally — the ability does not apply to their damage.
ability.ex_immunity.summary_de: Bekommt 0 Schaden von Pokemon-ex Angriffen. Nicht-ex Pokemon greifen normal an — die Fähigkeit gilt nicht für deren Schaden.

ability.bench_protection.desc: Prevents damage done to Benched Pokemon. Examples: Manaphy (Wave Veil), Mr. Mime, Jirachi-style protection.
ability.bench_protection.summary_en: Prevents damage done to the Benched Pokemon by attacks. Front-line damage still lands as usual.
ability.bench_protection.summary_de: Verhindert Schaden auf den Bank-Pokemon durch Angriffe. Schaden auf das aktive Pokemon landet weiter normal.

ability.damage_reduction.desc: Reduces incoming damage by a fixed amount (e.g. '-30 damage from attacks'). Eats away at attacker math but doesn't fully prevent KO.
ability.damage_reduction.summary_en: Reduces incoming damage by a flat amount — attacks still land but lose a fixed chunk of damage.
ability.damage_reduction.summary_de: Reduziert eingehenden Schaden um einen festen Betrag — Angriffe landen weiter, aber mit weniger Schaden.

ability.bench_search.desc: Searches the deck for a specific category of Pokemon and benches them, accelerating board setup.
ability.bench_search.summary_en: Searches the deck for a specific Pokemon and puts it on the Bench — board-acceleration utility.
ability.bench_search.summary_de: Sucht das Deck nach einem bestimmten Pokemon und legt es auf die Bank — Board-Beschleunigung.

ability.gust_effect.desc: Switches one of the opponent's Benched Pokemon to the Active Spot.
ability.gust_effect.summary_en: Drags one of the opponent's Benched Pokemon into the Active Spot — picks off support pieces or sets up KOs.
ability.gust_effect.summary_de: Holt eines der Bank-Pokemon des Gegners aktiv — pickt Support ab oder bereitet KOs vor.

disruption.hand_reset.desc: Forces the opponent to shuffle their hand and draw a different (usually smaller) number of cards. Examples: Iono, N, Roxanne.
disruption.hand_reset.summary_en: Forces the opponent to shuffle their hand and draw a different number of cards — disrupts setup turns.
disruption.hand_reset.summary_de: Zwingt den Gegner Hand zu shufflen und eine andere Kartenzahl zu ziehen — stört Setup-Züge.
